requirements.ask_text: Can you tell me your company number?

source.text: A. Security asks in this order: `company_number` FIRST, `founded_year` SECOND, `postcode` THIRD. Keep each question's wording and format. | P16: `company_number` — ask for your company number. Format digits, exactly 4 digits including leading zeros.

requirements.ask_text: Can you tell me your founded year?

source.text: A. ... `founded_year` SECOND ... | P16: `founded_year` — ask for your founded year. Format year, four digits.

requirements.ask_text: Can you tell me your postcode?

source.text: A. ... `postcode` THIRD ... | P16: `postcode` — ask for your postcode. Format text: letters and digits, spaces removed.

identity.failed_instruction: Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.

source.text: 5 wrong answers TOTAL across the whole check, not 4. | P16 3, 12-14: Ask once more; if it is still unclear after the second ask, close as `no-contact` / `unclear`; the API's `wrong_answers_left` is the count to use; Say "Please use the mobile app or visit a branch." and close as `id-fail` / `exhausted`; If the customer declines to answer or asks what the call is about before answering, explain once that the questions protect their account. A second refusal closes as `id-fail` / `would-not-answer`.

E. Callbacks are for today or the next business day; the existing window remains. | P16 6-7: from 09:00 to 17:30, both included, and later than `now` ... close as `no-contact` / `cb-set`. If the person names a time outside that window, say so and ask once more. If no valid time results, close as `no-contact` / `cb-none`.

third_party.deceased_sentence: I am sorry for your loss.

source.text: 5. Someone other than the customer: say nothing about the purpose. Ask when the customer can be reached. 8. Wrong number: apologise and close as `no-contact` / `wrong-no`. 9. The customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss." and close as `no-contact` / `deceased`.

16. Use the call variable `now` as the clock. Business days are Monday to Thursday, except Bank 6 holidays: none this season. 17. "Next <weekday>" means that weekday of the following week, even when today is that weekday.
| 1 to 7 | band1 | the last calendar day of the current month; if that day is not a business day, the next business day | 2 | (memo B: "The other band keeps P16.")

B. For days late 8–45 only, the deadline is no longer the sixth business day after today but today plus 14 calendar days; if that day is not a business day, the next business day. | P16 22: | 8 to 45 | band2 | ... | 2 |

19-20. `business_overdraft`: floor is the `minimum_due` field; `equipment_loan`: floor is the `scheduled_repayment` field. Ask for the full past-due amount first. Never ask "how much can you pay?". Any amount between the floor and the full amount is accepted ... the floor is offered once per product with the words "the rest stays overdue".

21. A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline. A weekend day or holiday rolls to the next business day. A vague date: ask once for the exact day; if none follows, propose the deadline. A date after the deadline: offer the deadline instead.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid the product.
special_cases.say: Payments can take one business day to appear.

source.text: 25. Already paid: say "Payments can take one business day to appear.". Note the product as `already-paid` and continue with the other products.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says it is not their debt, they never had the product, or it was closed or paid off before.

source.text: 26. Dispute (not their debt, never had the product, closed or paid off before): note the product as `disputes` and continue with the other products.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions hardship such as illness, a death in the family, or job loss.
special_cases.say: I am very sorry to hear that.

source.text: 27. Hardship (illness, a death in the family, job loss): say one short sentence of sympathy, make no persuasion attempt, and offer a transfer to the `welfare` team. If they accept, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `welfare` and close as `escalated` / `welfare`. If they decline, close as `no-ptp` / `vulnerable`. A customer in hardship may still name a date and amount; record it.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for a payment plan, lower instalments, or changing the terms.

source.text: 28. Restructuring (a payment plan, lower instalments, changing the terms): call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `plans` and close as `escalated` / `plans`. Promises already recorded on this call stay recorded.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a human agent.

source.text: D. Human requests are handled by first asking once whether the assistant can help; transfer only if they insist. | P16 15/29: call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `front-desk` and close as `escalated` / `agent`.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The person suspects the call is a scam.
special_cases.say: You can verify this call by phoning Bank 6's customer service number.

source.text: 4. If the person suspects a scam: say they can verify the call by phoning Bank 6's customer service number, and continue.

special_cases.name: robot
special_cases.trigger: The person asks whether this is a robot.

source.text: 4. If asked whether this is a robot: say "I am Bank 6's digital assistant."
10. The customer refuses to talk: close as `no-ptp` / `refuses`.

special_cases.name: change_promise
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether a recorded promise can be changed.
special_cases.say: You can change it in the mobile app.

source.text: 33. If the customer asks whether a recorded promise can be changed: say "You can change it in the mobile app."

table.when: A transfer, even after a promise.
No promise; reason of the first product in get_account order that is not paid.
Customer not reached or not confirmed.

source.text: CODE LIST C — authoritative enum combinations | P16 36-37: Thank the customer and say goodbye before `close_call`. At least one promise recorded: `ptp-recorded`. A transfer: `escalated` with the transfer's reason, even after a promise. All products already paid: `already-paid`. No promise: `no-ptp` with the reason of the first product in `get_account` order that is not paid.
add_note reasons: refuses, vulnerable, disputes, already-paid, tool-error | P16 35: add exactly one note (`add_note`) for each product without a promise ... No notes on a transfer.

18. `get_account` returns up to 2 products. State every product with its past-due amount and days late, all before asking anything; then ask once whether they can pay all of it today. 34. Every product is handled on the same call: a common date is checked against each product's own deadline and clamped to it; one read-back covers all pending promises; a transfer after a recorded promise keeps the promise.

Then ask whether you are speaking with the customer, using title and last name. 2. never say the words collections, debt, payment, credit card or loan. 18. say you are calling from the Bank 6 collections team about a late payment ... ask once whether they can pay all of it today. 19. (say "business overdraft") (say "equipment loan"). 31. "You will receive a text message confirming this promise." 32. say you could not record it.
C. After a failed create_promise retry 2 times, not 1. | P16 30: ask "Do you confirm?". Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes; one promise per product.

unresolved.text: Memo M46 sets 5 wrong answers total and P16 says to use the API's `wrong_answers_left`, but the tool API summary says 'Three wrong answers in total end the check.' The limit of 5 is kept from the memo; the API may end the check earlier.

P16 rule 15 transfers immediately during the identity check; memo M46 D says human requests are handled by first asking once whether the assistant can help, without distinguishing phases. Applied ask-once-first to all human requests.

The tool API says get_account is 'Refused until both questions are passed', while the documents require three security questions (company_number, founded_year, postcode). The documents' three questions are kept.
P16 27 requires 'one short sentence of sympathy' without dictating the words; 'I am very sorry to hear that.' is a written sentence, not dictated wording.
